_: A Space's repository for the Releases timeline (Tests/test_ritual_releases.py builds it as a git repository in a temporary folder; nothing here is a real project). `commits` are made in order, each on its own day at noon UTC, `tags` naming the release tags (a -rc tag is a checkpoint and is not a release); the last commit carries `files`: the changelog and the entries waiting in changelog.d/. `origin` names the branch whose tip is copied to refs/remotes/origin/<branch> (the Space's default branch, as a fetched clone has it; absent: a clone with no origin ref). `side` are branches made after the commits, each from a tag or a branch, with its own commits (and tags, and the files it adds); the one marked `checkout` is what the clone has checked out at the end, so its commits must NOT be in the release in progress, and a tag on a branch never merged into the default branch is not a release. `milestones` are gh's own rows for the repository. `issueTitles` are GitHub's titles for the issues the log names, as the titles read answers them (an issue missing here is one GitHub could not resolve). `source` is the route's `source`: the ref the release in progress was read to. `expected` is what GET /api/ritual/releases serves, release by release, newest first, the one in progress first. `variants` change one thing about the same clone -- no origin ref, or a configured default branch the clone does not have -- and state the ref read and the release in progress then.
